<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M peak, ~9 % M+1, and very low higher‑mass peaks—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution (≈1.1 % per carbon). No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
